snippet.title: Grit and Valor - 1949 | Official VR Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Grit and Valor – 1949 is going virtual!

Take command like never before in this immersive VR evolution of ultimate dieselpunk WWII experience.

⚙️ Manoeuvre powerful mechs by hand
🛠️ Select upgrades and control the battlefield with intuitive VR mechanics
💥 Control your view of the battlefield

🎮 Launching 21 August on Meta Quest, SteamVR, and PSVR2

Already own the game on Steam or PS5?
You’ll receive the VR version free of charge — no extra purchase needed!

👉 Play today: https://s.team/a/1911860

Join the community & stay updated!
💬 Discord – https://discord.gg/8eqDpa88nf
📹 TikTok – https://www.tiktok.com/@gritandvalor1949
🐦 X (Twitter) – https://x.com/Grit_and_Valor
📸 Instagram – https://www.instagram.com/gritandvalor1949/
